reconcile.note: Gill and Matthew Henry read the lament of verse 44 as covenant discipline within history that does not deny or revoke the everlasting oath sworn in verses 35-37.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells presses the psalm's plain wording: God swore under oath that David's line and throne would last forever, yet that line ended with Zedekiah and no such king reigns today.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible.

sides.snippet: His seed will endure forever, His throne like the sun before me.
